en: The postcard displays a sepia-toned photograph of a historic Italian square with a prominent clock tower, a medieval building, and a large church with a rose window and distinctive architectural details. The caption at the top reads 'Un Saluto da Trento,' suggesting greetings from Trento. Along the bottom, the text specifies 'Piazza Colla Torre E Parte Del Duomo,' indicating the view is of the square with the tower and part of the cathedral. There is also a visible purple ink stamp from Darmstadt.
